network_enforcement: The checker performs local reconciliation and invokes check_proof.sh, whose trust-zero Lean processes use only the existing pinned environment and a fresh temporary directory. This worker recipe makes no release-grade isolation claim.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line negative release summary bound in release-receipt.json

scope_boundary: This bounded worker recipe authenticates current release inputs, replays the exact statement, conditional composition, and partial cyclotomic-identification body at trust zero, and checks a negative release decision. It cannot accept the validation dependency, construct any of the five open mathematical packages, close the exact root, supply H0/R0 or complete trust/provenance evidence, perform a cold offline release build, act as an independent verifier, or grant release/master acceptance.
